diagnosis.overall_diagnosis: Q1 expected 11 contributors (authors + key reviewers) but the agent returned only 8 — it limited reviewers to meeting participants of a single planning meeting and included the author in that set. The skill's 'key reviewer extraction rules' need stronger guidance to aggregate reviewers/contributors across ALL related artifacts (multiple meetings, PR reviewers, doc comment threads, slack review threads) and to union authors + reviewers without deduping prematurely or restricting to one meeting.

diagnosed_skills.diagnosis: The skill's reviewer extraction heuristics led the agent to equate 'key reviewers' with participants of a single planning meeting (CoFoAIX_planning_1), yielding 8 IDs instead of the 11 expected. It did not instruct the agent to union contributors across ALL related artifacts (every planning/review meeting, PR reviewers, doc revision/comment authors, Slack review threads) linked to the target document, nor to combine authors + reviewers as the final answer set when the question asks for both.
diagnosed_skills.repair_instruction: Strengthen the 'Key reviewer extraction rules' section with explicit multi-artifact aggregation steps: (1) Identify the target document and resolve its product codename (e.g., CoachForce↔CoFoAIX) before searching. (2) Enumerate ALL artifacts referencing that document — every meeting (not just one planning meeting), every PR touching the doc or its codebase, every Slack/chat thread referencing the doc_id or title, and every revision/comment author on the doc itself. (3) For 'authors and key reviewers' style questions, build the result as the UNION of: explicit author field(s) + anyone with an explicit 'reviewer'/'approver' role on PRs or doc metadata + anyone who provided substantive review feedback (comments, suggested edits, review-meeting speaking turns with content-level feedback) across ALL related meetings/threads. Do NOT restrict to a single meeting's participant list and do NOT exclude the author. (4) Add a checklist: 'Before finalizing, list every artifact ID consulted and confirm you searched >1 meeting and checked PRs + chat threads.' (5) Warn that participant lists of one meeting are a common under-count failure mode; cross-reference across artifact types until the contributor set stabilizes.
